proposals.before: He was appointed investigating censor at Jingzhou.
proposals.after: He was appointed prefectural judge at Jingzhou.
proposals.reason: 荊州推官 is the prefectural judge (pusher of cases), not an investigating censor (御史).

proposals.after: Yunzhen was appointed assistant magistrate of Xu prefecture.
proposals.reason: 許州 is Xu prefecture (modern Xuchang), not 徐州 Xuzhou; 判官 is an assistant magistrate/judge, not 'vice magistrate of Xuzhou'.

proposals.before: Your Majesty should together with the assistant ministers carefully scrutinize the heads of the two ministries and restore their proper duties to them.
proposals.after: Your Majesty should together with the grand secretaries carefully scrutinize the heads of the two ministries and restore their proper duties to them.

proposals.after: The next year Zhong, because Xia county magistrate Peng Yingchun resisted his ceremonial precedence, impeached and demoted him.
proposals.reason: 夏縣 is Xia county; the literal rendering Xian county mistranslates the place-name.

proposals.before: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he was posthumously enfeoffed Jie Su.
proposals.after: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he was granted the posthumous name Jiesu.
proposals.reason: 追謚 is a posthumous name, not an enfeoffment.

proposals.after: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he was granted the posthumous name Jiesu.
proposals.reason: 追謚 is a posthumous name, not an enfeoffment.

proposals.after: He went out again as vice commissioner of Shanxi and served in succession as commissioner of transmission at Nanjing.
proposals.reason: 南京通政使 is the Office of Transmission, not a transport post.

proposals.before: He went out again as Vice Commissioner of Shanxi and served in succession as Vice Commissioner of Transport at Nanjing.
proposals.after: He went out again as Vice Commissioner of Shanxi and served in succession as Commissioner of Transmission at Nanjing.
proposals.reason: 南京通政使 is the Office of Transmission, not a transport post.

proposals.before: He was promoted to right vice minister of the Court of Judicial Review and resigned on account of illness.
proposals.after: He was promoted to right assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review and resigned on account of illness.
proposals.reason: 大理右寺丞 is an assistant director (寺丞), not a vice minister (少卿 or 侍郎).

proposals.before: When Yunzhen spoke on affairs and offended the chief minister, Sancai submitted a forceful memorial in his defense and was demoted to investigating censor of Dongchang.
proposals.after: When Yunzhen spoke on affairs and offended the chief minister, Sancai submitted a forceful memorial in his defense and was demoted to judge of Dongchang.

proposals.before: He was transferred to assistant administration commissioner of Shandong.
proposals.after: He was transferred to assistant surveillance commissioner of Shandong.
proposals.reason: 山東僉事 here is a surveillance assistant, not an administration commissioner.

proposals.before: In the twenty-seventh year (1599) he was made right vice censor-in-chief, concurrently grand coordinator of transport, and grand coordinator of the prefectures of Fengyang and elsewhere.
proposals.after: In the twenty-seventh year (1599) he was made right vice censor-in-chief, director-general of grain transport, and grand coordinator of the prefectures of Fengyang and elsewhere.
proposals.reason: 總督漕運 is the grain-transport director-general, not a generic grand coordinator of transport.

proposals.before: Surveillance Commissioner Cui Bangliang of Huai-Yang, Transport Surveillance Commissioner Li Sixiao, supervising secretaries Cao Yubian, Shi Xueqian, and Yuan Jiugao, and censors all submitted linked memorials begging him to stay.
proposals.after: The Huai-Yang regional inspecting censor Cui Bangliang, the grain-transport inspecting censor Li Sixiao, supervising secretary Cao Yubian, and censors Shi Xueqian and Yuan Jiugao submitted linked memorials begging him to stay.
proposals.reason: Chinese lists 給事中 only before 曹於汴; 御史史學遷、袁九臯 are both censors. The English wrongly makes Shi Xueqian and Yuan Jiugao supervising secretaries and adds a leftover 'and censors'.

proposals.before: Surveillance Commissioner Cui Bangliang of Huai-Yang, Transport Surveillance Commissioner Li Sixiao, supervising secretaries Cao Yubian, Shi Xueqian, and Yuan Jiugao, and censors all submitted linked memorials begging him to stay.
proposals.after: The Huai-Yang regional inspecting censor Cui Bangliang, the grain-transport inspecting censor Li Sixiao, supervising secretary Cao Yubian, and censors Shi Xueqian and Yuan Jiugao submitted linked memorials begging him to stay.
proposals.reason: The literal matches the idiomatic error: 御史 modifies both Shi Xueqian and Yuan Jiugao, and 給事中 modifies only Cao Yubian.

proposals.before: Before long Nanjing Bureau of Military Affairs Director Qian Ce, Nanjing supervising secretaries Liu Shijun, censors Liu Guoji, Qiao Yingjia, supervising secretaries Wang Shaozheng, Xu Shaoji, Zhou Yongchun, Yao Zongwen, Zhu Yigui, and Li Jin, and Nanjing censors Zhang Bangjun and Wang Wanzuo again submitted linked memorials impeaching Sancai.
proposals.after: Before long Nanjing Bureau of Military Affairs Director Qian Ce, Nanjing supervising secretary Liu Shijun, censors Liu Guoji and Qiao Yingjia, supervising secretaries Wang Shaozheng, Xu Shaoji, Zhou Yongchun, Yao Zongwen, Zhu Yigui, and Li Jin, and Nanjing censors Zhang Bangjun and Wang Wanzuo again submitted linked memorials impeaching Sancai.
proposals.reason: Chinese has a single 南京給事中劉時俊, not plural secretaries covering Liu Shijun together with later names.

proposals.before: An edict then ordered Zhengyi together with supervising secretary Wu Liang to go in succession.
proposals.after: An edict then ordered Zhengyi together with supervising secretary Wu Liangsi to go.
proposals.reason: 吳亮嗣 is Wu Liangsi, not Wu Liang; 往 means they were sent, not 'go in succession'.

proposals.before: Speaking of worthy junior officials: Mei Zhihuan, Sun Zhenji, Duan Ran, Wu Liang, Ma Mengzhen, Tang Zhaojing, Zhou Qiyuan, Shi Xueqian, Qian Chun, and others have gone; Li Pu, Bao Ying'ao, Ding Yuansian, Pang Shiyong, Wu Zhengzhi, Liu Zongzhou, and others have gone.
proposals.after: Speaking of worthy junior officials: Mei Zhihuan, Sun Zhenji, Duan Ran, Wu Liang, Ma Mengzhen, Tang Zhaojing, Zhou Qiyuan, Shi Xueqian, Qian Chun, and others have gone; Li Pu, Bao Ying'ao, Ding Yuanjian, Pang Shiyong, Wu Zhengzhi, Liu Zongzhou, and others have gone.
proposals.reason: 丁元薦 is Ding Yuanjian, not Ding Yuansian.

proposals.before: Liang and his successors had already gone to investigate; after a long while they obtained nothing.
proposals.after: Liangsi and the others had already gone to investigate; after a long while they obtained nothing.
proposals.reason: 亮嗣 abbreviates 吳亮嗣; 等 is companions, not successors.

proposals.before: Participating Secretary of the Office of Transmission Wu Dianbang argued forcefully that he could not be used, going so far as to call him a treacherous minister.
proposals.after: Participating Secretary of the Office of Transmission Wu Dianbang argued forcefully that he could not be used, going so far as to call him a robber-minister.
proposals.reason: 盜臣 echoes the theft charge, not generic treachery.

proposals.before: Those who later attacked Sancai, such as Shao Fuzhong and Xu Zhaokui, were all because they attached themselves to Wei Zhongxian listed in the roster of treason.
proposals.after: Those who later attacked Sancai, such as Shao Fuzhong and Xu Zhaokui, were all listed in the roster of treason because they attached themselves to Wei Zhongxian.
proposals.reason: English word order is ungrammatical; 鹹 stands for 咸 'all'.

decisions.reason: The English gloss of the heading note should not retain the Chinese book-title closer 〉 after the parenthesis.
授荊州推官 names a prefectural judge; 御史 appears only later when he is summoned as censor.
許州判官 is assistant magistrate of Xu prefecture (Xuchang), not of 徐州 Xuzhou.
In this memorial 輔臣 are the grand secretaries, contrasted with 部臣, not assistant ministers.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 陛下宜與輔臣精察二部之長

decisions.reason: 夏縣 is Xia county; the literal 'Xian county' misreads 夏.
追謚介肅 grants the posthumous name Jiesu; it is not an enfeoffment.
The same 追謚 clause names a posthumous title, so the literal must not say he was enfeoffed.
南京通政使 is commissioner of the Office of Transmission, not a vice commissioner of transport.
The literal likewise misreads 通政使 as a transport vice-commissionership.
大理右寺丞 is a temple assistant director; 少卿 for vice minister appears only later as 大理左少卿.
坐謫東昌推官 demotes him to prefectural judge of Dongchang, not investigating censor.
遷山東僉事 is a provincial surveillance assistant, not an administration-commission post, which the next unit names as 參議.
總督漕運 is director-general of grain transport; 巡撫 is the separate grand-coordinator title for Fengyang.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以右僉都御史總督漕運，巡撫鳳陽諸府

decisions.reason: 給事中 governs only 曹於汴; 御史 governs 史學遷 and 袁九臯; 巡按御史 and 巡漕御史 are inspecting censors, not surveillance commissioners.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 淮揚巡按御史崔邦亮、巡漕御史李思孝、給事中曹於汴、御史史學遷、袁九臯

decisions.reason: The literal repeats the same mis-grouping of titles; the Chinese title sequence is decisive.

decisions.reason: 南京給事中 applies only to 劉時俊; the following 御史 pair is Liu Guoji and Qiao Yingjia.

decisions.reason: 吳亮嗣 is Wu Liangsi; 偕…往 sends Zhengyi together with him, not 'in succession'.

decisions.reason: 丁元薦 is Ding Yuanjian; Yuansian is a misreading of 薦.
亮嗣 abbreviates 吳亮嗣; 等 marks the investigating party, not later successors.
盜臣 is a minister who steals, not a generic treacherous minister (奸臣).
鹹/咸以附魏忠賢名麗逆案 means they were all listed in the treason roster because they attached themselves to Wei Zhongxian; the original English is ungrammatical.

label.en: vice commissioner of transmission at Nanjing

claimRevisions.reason: 通政使 is the commissioner of the Office of Transmission, not a vice commissioner.
The English personal name Wu Liang was produced by dropping 嗣 from 吳亮嗣.
The extracted English name Ding Yuansian misreads 薦; the source name is 丁元薦.
